List<int> parseNestedParens(String parenString) {
  final stack = <int>[];
  final result = <int>[];

  for (final char in parenString.split('')) {
    if (char == '(') {
      // Push current length to the stack
      stack.add(result.length);
    } else if (char == ')') {
      if (stack.isEmpty) {
        throw FormatException('Mismatched parentheses');
      }
      final start = stack.removeLast();
      // Calculate the number of nested pairs between start and end index
      final count = result.length - start;
      result[start] = count; // Overwrite with the count at the starting index
    }
  }

}

List<int> parseNestedParens(String parenString) {
  final List<int> result = [];
  int depth = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < parenString.length; ++i) {
    if (parenString[i] == '(') {
      depth++;
      if (depth > result.length) {
        result.add(1);
      } else {
        result[depth - 1]++;
      }
    } else if (parenString[i] == ')') {
      depth--;
      if (depth >= 0) {
        result[depth]--;
      }
    }
  }
  return result;
}

List<int> sortArray(List<int> array) {
  // Create a copy of the original list to avoid modifying it directly.
  List<int> sorted = [...array];
  
  int n = sorted.length;
  
  for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    int minIndex = i;
    
    // Find the index of the minimum element in the unsorted part.
    for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
      if (sorted[j] < sorted[minIndex]) {
        minIndex = j;
      }
    }
    
    // Swap the found minimum element with the first element of the unsorted part.
    int temp = sorted[i];
    sorted[i] = sorted[minIndex];
    sorted[minIndex] = temp;
  }
  
  return sorted;
}
